distance_quota_rule: largest remainder proportional to model-blind geometric eligible ordered 64-cell-pair counts; shared by all samplers within city
cluster: four geographic-coordinate clusters per occupied 64 cell; five Lloyd iterations; replacement initialization; choose one random member of largest cluster; deterministic first ties
uniform_grid: up to four distinct nodes per occupied 64 cell; first sampled node is source; all sampled nodes are destinations
hierarchical_grid: nearest node to each occupied 128 subcell center, original-ID ties; source and destination representatives
reverse_od_role: same candidate role for both directions
candidate_role_note: candidate-domain partition probabilities only; final corpus counts retain 80/10/10; all future_G1_test-role candidates excluded from every G0 corpus
label_arithmetic: long double scalar Dijkstra; float64 arrival sidecars; original node path and integer canonical knots permit exact rational reconstruction; all routes replayed edge by edge, one rational witness per SSSP

training.shuffle: one complete seeded permutation per epoch; each row once

primary_selection_metric: q = min(point micro recall, point micro F1); exact all-score sweep on Vselect
epoch_tie_break: global max-q within 1e-8, then fewer mean predicted cells, greater precision, earlier epoch
calibration: same exact max-q sweep and compactness/high-threshold tie rule on Vcal only, after checkpoint selection

inference.handoff: road support filter then insert known endpoints

reporting: point micro counts per complete seed/test; six rows report paired-seed mean and sample standard deviation; all seeds and failures retained
pipeline_order: complete XA seed42 chain before remaining seeds/BJ training; BJ label generation may follow completed XA labels
formal_timing: E1 is quality only; colocated wall time is not isolated inference latency
